critical.issue: Returns HTTPException(502) with structured detail, but k8s ingress replaces 5xx bodies with generic HTML 'Bad gateway' page. Frontend loses the friendly {code:'SEARCH_ERR'|'QUOTA', message:...} JSON and cannot show the Gujarati toast for a bad Google key. Fix: map bad-key / non-200 Google responses to HTTP 400/422 (client error), not 502; only true unreachable-network failures should be 502. server.py:445 and server.py:451.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend returns 502 (see backend critical), and ingress rewrites body to HTML, the client sees a non-JSON error and shows a generic 'Search failed' toast instead of the friendly QUOTA/SEARCH_ERR Gujarati message. NO_KEY path (400) works correctly because ingress does not intercept 4xx.

action_items: In server.py, change HTTPException(502, ...) for bad-key / non-200 Google responses to HTTPException(400) or 422 with the same structured detail body. Rationale: k8s/CDN swallows 5xx bodies and replaces with HTML. Keep 429 for QUOTA (429 is not touched by ingress). Lines: server.py:445 (network exception) and server.py:451 (SEARCH_ERR).

rca_of_issue: Bad-key friendly error is technically implemented in server.py (raises HTTPException(502, detail={code:'SEARCH_ERR', message:'...'})). However, the emergent preview proxy intercepts ALL 5xx responses and replaces the response body with a generic Cloudflare-style HTML 'Bad gateway' page BEFORE it reaches the client. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/auth/settings {google_api_key:'BADKEY',google_cx:'badcx'}; (2) POST /api/search/web {part_number:'X'}; (3) client receives 502 with Content-Type text/html and body '<!DOCTYPE html>...preview.emergentagent.com | 502: Bad gateway...'. Backend log confirms FastAPI itself returned the 502 with structured detail. Mitigation: use client-error status codes (400/422) for user-actionable errors (bad key, non-200 Google response) so the ingress does not swallow the JSON body. Keep 429 for QUOTA (unaffected) and reserve 5xx only for true server bugs/unreachable network.
